scope: retrospective descriptive comparison of one frozen cohort; no tuning or causal claims
cohort: all 154 original snapshot rows, preserve ps/pc and rating
priorMatching: nearest point to t-7200 within inclusive +/-900 seconds; tie earlier; strictly before t
posteriorMatching: same as 15C: nearest to t+7200 within inclusive +/-900 seconds; tie earlier
peers: other cards present in original snapshot, same platform and rating, exclude own identity; retain original membership
minimumPeersRationale: diagnostic guard against one or two peers, not a validated statistical sample size or production threshold; publish counts and ranges
priorPeerAvailability: only earlier points; do not condition prior trend benchmark on future visibility
posteriorPeerAvailability: endpoint available; report missing and survivor-selection limitation
metrics: prior and posterior price change percent
card return minus peer median in percentage points
gap from frozen pre-update fast and daily EMA
missing: null metric plus counts; no price imputation, no identity substitution
excluded: new network collection or R2 writes
